# Shell

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/shell.md`.

- SH-01 prefer: Use `#!/bin/sh` and POSIX constructs for provisioning snippets on a bare VM or minimal container; use `#!/usr/bin/env bash` only when you need arrays, `[[ ]]` or functions. [tool:shellcheck]
- SH-02 must: In new scripts, start bash with `set -euo pipefail` and `sh` snippets with `set -eu`; existing scripts stay unless touched. Observed: mark accepted failures with `|| true` and bracket intentionally failing sections with `set +e` and `set -e`.
  Good: `set -euo pipefail` on line 2 of a bash script, then `grep -q ready "${log}" || true` for an accepted failure.
  Bad: a bash script with no `set -e` that carries on after a failed `cd`.
- SH-03 prefer: Label sections with `### name ###` in provisioning snippets (one per tool, lowercase) and `#region name` / `#endregion` in longer bash scripts.
- SH-04 lean: Shell: add one short lowercase comment above a block of commands that form a step, none above a line the command explains (PRIN-14).
- SH-05 lean: In multi-step scripts prefix each echo with a `[module]` tag and write `ERROR:` or `WARNING:` after it; send errors to stderr.
- SH-06 must: Pass shellcheck in all scripts, including `assets/**/*.sh`, and add no `.shellcheckrc`. Observed: quote every expansion as `"${var}"`. [tool:shellcheck]
  Good: `cp "${src}" "${dst}"`.
  Bad: `cp $src $dst`.
- SH-07 lean: Name positional arguments in uppercase at the top with defaults (`SOURCE_PATH=${2:-.}`); declare function locals lowercase with `local` and assign command substitutions on a separate line. [tool:shellcheck]
- SH-08 prefer: Record the installed version in `/opt/<app>.version` and skip or restore only when it differs or is missing.
- SH-09 prefer: Name new Go template files (scripts, compose files) `.tpl`; rename existing `.j2` files when you refactor them and leave the rest.
- SH-10 must: In scripts embedded in Flux manifests write shell variables as `$${VAR}` and Flux substitutions as `${VAR}`.
  Good: `echo "$${HOST} uses ${CLUSTER_NAME}"` in a ConfigMap script (shell `HOST`, Flux `CLUSTER_NAME`).
  Bad: `echo "${HOST}"` for a shell variable, which Flux replaces with an empty string.
- SH-11 lean: Keep real logic in versioned script files; embedded ConfigMap scripts are thin wrappers that install dependencies and call the script.
- SH-12 prefer: Parameterize scripts and compose files with Go-template placeholders (`{{ .name }}`, spaces inside braces, camelCase keys) and keep a `prepare`, `install`, `postinstall` triple per component.

Avoid (AI-Era Artifacts):

- `Args:` / `Returns:` / `Notes:` docblocks per function (HA `util.sh`, 2026-08; the owner's 2023 scripts have none). If a sourced helper file needs one, keep it to one line.
- Box-drawing banners and emoji status output (`validate-manifests.sh`).
- `set -euo pipefail` under `#!/bin/sh` (`immich-init`), which is not POSIX.
